$ flow tasks
TASKS
  exec  Run one program from the deployment's allowlist and return its exit code
        and output.
  http  Perform an HTTP request and return the response. [takes secrets, defers
        inputs]
  log   Emit a message for a person to read. [no outputs]

`flow tasks <name>` describes one task in full: every input, what bounds it, and
a step to copy. `flow tasks --expressions` is what every expression in a
Flowfile can say.
$
